supersedesBlocker: docs/provenance/weapon-reskin.json recorded (2026-08-06) that archetype meshes could not be produced: no image->3D tool present, and Abyssal-Surge has no retained dagger/bow/hammer source mesh (only the generic blade/relic props convert_equip_props.py rebinds). D8 (frozen 2026-08-07) resolves this by procedural low-poly authoring in Blender headless instead of image->3D, following the same silhouette-tier convention as tools/blender/convert_equip_props.py.

conventions.socketSpace: grip/pivot at origin, striking end along +Y after FBX export (matches ActorView.AttachEquipProps RightHand pose, Assets/Scripts/View/ActorView.cs:392-421)
conventions.tierMaterials: basic = prop-charcoal (0.13,0.11,0.16) unlit-ish rough; fine = prop-ember (0.22,0.12,0.10 base + 0.95,0.35,0.17 emission) at 1.22x scale — same tier convention already shipped for equip-weapon-basic/fine, equip-lantern-basic/fine, equip-cloak-basic/fine

shapes.dagger: cylinder grip + box crossguard + 4-sided cone blade, 0.42m grip-to-tip
shapes.bow: central cylinder grip + 2x4 tapering curved limb segments + thin string cylinder, 1.05m tip-to-tip
shapes.hammer: cylinder handle + rectangular striking head with two end caps, 0.88m handle-to-head
